_comment: Copy this to secrets.json and fill it in. secrets.json is in .gitignore and must never be committed. The credentials here are the YouTube Data API key and the laptop's key to the project's private R2 bucket, which cloud.py uses; on GitHub the R2 values are repository secrets instead. The General Court's own database credentials are published by them for public use, so they live in probe_db.py in the open.
youtube_api_key: your YouTube Data API v3 key, from console.cloud.google.com
R2_ACCOUNT_ID: your Cloudflare account ID, from the R2 page of the dashboard
R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID: your R2 API token's access key ID (Object Read & Write, this bucket only)
R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: your R2 API token's secret access key
